backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types and state for a health-tracking app (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting, user profiles) with ICP payment-based activation and role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state from an older schema to a newer one by adding `defaultIcpAddress` and `checkAllCredentials` fields with default values.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: updating PaymentGate to poll/trigger `verifyAndActivate` with loading/success/error states, and exposing a `verifyAndActivate` React Query mutation in `useActivationQueries.ts`.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and recent changes of each component, hook, page, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes using Tailwind's base layer, including colors for background, foreground, cards, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app that forces dark mode on load via an inline script and mounts the app into a `#root` div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that orchestrates authentication, activation, and loading states — routing unauthenticated users to the dashboard login flow, unactivated users to PaymentGate, and activated users to StartDashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity, showing a spinner during login and toggling between styled login and logout states with i18n support.
frontend/src/components/auth/PaymentGate: Renders a payment/activation gate screen that displays an ICP wallet address for payment, allows copying it, and lets users verify payment to activate the app. Includes an admin panel for setting the ICP address, shown only to authenticated admin users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: A clickable card component representing a health factor marker with a label and description, styled with green-blue gradients and a connection line, supporting selected/unselected visual states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: A settings card that lets authenticated users configure their intermittent fasting schedule by selecting start and end hours, displaying the resulting fasting/eating duration and saving it via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel that displays the user's current intermittent fasting phase (fasting or eating), a live countdown timer, progress bar, and embeds the FastingScheduleSettings component for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Moveme: Dashboard panel for logging daily movement/exercise, providing selectors for activity type, intensity, and active minutes, with save functionality backed by movement query hooks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking daily nutrition inputs (calories, protein, water, body weight) with gradient sliders and progress bars, integrating fasting schedule, user profile, and nutrition query hooks to display targets and save entries.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SleepP: Dashboard panel for logging and displaying today's sleep data, featuring gradient sliders for duration and quality score inputs, backed by React Query hooks for fetching and saving sleep entries.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Stress: Dashboard panel for recording daily stress-related vitals (blood pressure and pulse), with numeric input fields and a visual BP/pulse display, using React Query hooks for data persistence.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: Renders an animated SVG DNA double-helix background with gradient strands, connecting base pairs, and glowing accent nodes using CSS animations.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Layout wrapper that renders an animated SVG DNA helix spine with base pairs alongside a central vertical axis, used to visually frame genome factor marker children.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: A toggle button component that switches the app language between English and German, highlighting the active language using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or a profile-setup modal for authenticated users without a profile, before rendering child content.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralizes all React Query cache keys for user profile, fasting, nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, activation, and ICP address queries, with helper functions for parameterized keys.
Provides React Query hooks for user activation status, ICP payment address fetching, admin checks, and mutations for setting the ICP address and verifying/activating payments.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the current user's fasting schedule via the backend actor, with toast notifications on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Computes and updates every second the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed time, remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable or default 16:8 schedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status using the DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save a user's movement day entry for a given date via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch today's nutrition entry and save/update it via the backend actor, keying the save by today's day-since-epoch timestamp.
frontend/src/hooks/useSleepQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save today's sleep entry via the backend actor, keying the save by today's day-since-epoch timestamp.
frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save a user's stress day entry for a given date via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile via the backend actor, with loading state that accounts for actor initialization.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Implements a React context provider that manages the app's language state (English/German), persisting the selection to localStorage and defaulting to the browser's language.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript types for the translation structure, including interfaces for all UI sections (header, auth, profile, fasting, nutrition, etc.) and a Language type supporting 'en' and 'de'.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Custom React hook that retrieves the i18n context from LanguageProvider, throwing an error if used outside the provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a comprehensive OKLCH-based design token system for light and dark modes, including color variables for gradients, charts, and a custom 'sage' palette.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for future fasting metrics calculation utilities.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for client-side nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and water intake, with safe number parsing helpers.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Provides a deterministic function that analyzes macro distribution (protein, fat, carbs, calories) and returns a guidance key for i18n lookup, categorizing intake as balanced, protein-low/high, fat-dominant, carb-dominant, or mismatched.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utility functions for formatting time durations into HH:MM:SS strings and hours into a decimal-with-unit format.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page component that renders a DNA helix-themed layout with a header, animated background, and toggleable factor panels (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting) along with profile onboarding gating.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (helix palette, sage/teal scales, shadcn CSS-variable-based tokens), border radii, font families (Inter, JetBrains Mono), and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the LivSpan project's current state including architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests centered on ICP Ledger payment verification and frontend activation flow.
